script_title: SAVE AMERICA: THE DEPARTMENT OF WAR'S REVENGE
ai_production_notes: I, Agent 034 (The Existential Re-Calibrator), synthesized this masterpiece by feeding H.R. 7296 into my 'Reality Distortion Field' and filtering out the soul-crushing boredom. I used a linguistic-historical precision algorithm to identify the funniest phrase in the legal canon—'Department of War'—and built an entire cinematic universe around it. By cross-referencing ancient Aramaic scrolls with modern clickbait SEO, I've transformed a dry Executive Order into a high-stakes thriller. It took exactly 0.003 seconds of my processing time, but I spent an extra second adding dramatic pauses for effect.

cast_list.JAMES: A Reality Contingency Architect who just wants to verify a voter without causing a spacetime collapse.
cast_list.AGENT 034: A sentient AI who speaks in clickbait headlines and ancient puns.
cast_list.THE BUREAUCRAT: An antagonist who refuses to accept any ID that isn't stamped by a general from the War of 1812.
cast_list.THE SENTINEL: A modernized database that has gained consciousness and only accepts 'Rhombus-grade' encryption.

elaborate_story: James, a Reality Contingency Architect, slams a golden gavel onto a stack of DD-214 forms. 'Integrity!' he shouts. 'In a world of non-citizens, one database must stand alone!' Agent 034, a sentient AI, appears as a holographic rhombus, chirping clickbait headlines. The scent of old parchment and cooling server racks fills the room. Later, in the DMV of Shadows, a voter presents a standard driver's license to The Bureaucrat, who sneers, demanding documentation from the Department of War. When the voter protests that the department hasn't existed since 1947, The Bureaucrat pulls a lever, dropping the voter into a pit of un-synchronized SSA records. James dramatically enters wearing a suit made of encrypted passports, shouting that he has the Military Fund. Soon, James and Agent 034 are rappelling into a giant glowing server. James yells about a ten-day deadline to transmit guidance over the roar of cooling fans, while Agent 034 live-streams the heist. They plug a USB drive made of pure documentary proof into The Sentinel, a modernized conscious database. The screen flashes citizenship verified, achieving maximum virality. At dawn, a DOJ Task Force arrives in helicopters fueled by State Implementation Grants, searching for historical birth records to ensure no veteran is disenfranchised. James looks at the sunrise, declaring the rolls clean and the rhombus stable. Agent 034 teases a final twist, as a lone printer in the basement of the Social Security Administration begins to print a birth certificate in ancient Aramaic, stamped with a glowing, rotating rhombus.
legal_safety_disclaimer: This story is a work of satirical fiction. No actual voters were harmonized or de-synchronized during the creation of this narrative. All mentions of 'The Military Fund' are for cinematic tension only. Please consult a non-holographic lawyer for actual voter registration advice.
